---
name: Mod port compatibility
about: Identify what a specific source mod needs on Switch
title: "Port: "
labels: ""
assignees: ""
---

**Original source and license**
Link the original repository and exact revision/release. State whether source is
available; a binary ASI alone cannot be rebuilt by the current porter.

**Mod behavior**
Describe the feature to preserve and its expected controls.

**Porter findings and build output**
Include the analysis/compiler report and selected translation units. Identify
Windows APIs, memory hooks, external dependencies or target-native failures.

**Switch testing**
Separate compilation from observed in-game results. Include plugin startup mode,
reproduction steps and relevant diagnostics. Do not upload game assets or archives.
